typography.strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' Mobile Variant. Radical weight contrast. Technical but highly readable.
typography.primary_font: IBM Plex Sans (or system equivalent geometric sans)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tactile, sharp inner contrasts. Use solid colored backgrounds over glassmorphism to preserve reading clarity for technical text.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders on most cards. Use color-coded left-borders for Gate statuses.

GatesOverview.layout: Scrollable dashboard with top-level Higgins status card followed by individual Gate cards.
ui_details: Rename the navigation tab to 'Gates'. Replace 'Apollo is guarding what he can' with data-derived summary (e.g. 'Some protection needs attention').
Higgins Status Message: Shows precise explanation and Primary Button (e.g., 'Restore protection'). Triggers permission flow and re-verifies post-return.
Gate Cards: Represent Text Gate, Call Gate, Link Gate, Site Gate, Network Gate, Account Gate. Inventory remaining 'Guard' names and change to 'Gate'.
Each Gate card MUST display: 1) Current Status, 2) Capability summary, 3) Auto vs Manual mode, 4) Missing setup + 1 direct action to resolve.
Valid Gate Statuses: 'Active', 'Ready to check', 'Needs attention', 'Off', 'Unavailable on this device', 'Checking status'.
Move implementation details (VPN, DNS, Requested: on) behind 'More details'.

MessageAssessmentResult.layout: Bento-style scrollable view structured for clear evidence and Higgins' assessment.
ui_details: Structured Assessment: Identifies claimed organizations, numbers, domains, links, action, and suspected deception.
Higgins Voice: Clear assessment, specific verified/uncertain evidence, one primary safe action. Do not say 'no reports found' means safe.
Apollo State: Use 1 assessment to drive behavior (Resting, Growling, Barking, Biting) and labels/colors.
PayPal Example Support: Show alleged-charge callback trap investigation. Distinguish external verification from message evidence. Guide user to app.
Never show 'Ordinary message' or reassuring styling beside high-risk assessment.
Do not describe Higgins as performing blocking. Apollo does not speak.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. React Native Flexbox gaps: 4, 8, 16, 24, 32. Padding inside cards must be 16px minimum.
layouts.screen_structure: Use SafeAreaView. Header is minimal. Main content is ScrollView. Align dense content left, center only when needed for visual balance.

interactions: Apollo Animation States: Map 'Resting', 'Growling', 'Barking', 'Biting' directly to the unified threat assessment.
Ensure transition flows map accurately when permissions are granted/restored.
Use LayoutAnimation for expanding/collapsing 'Show details' and 'More details'.

accessibility.contrast: All text must meet APCA / WCAG AA standard against background. Higgins AI explanations must use high-contrast dark grey/black.
accessibility.screen_reader: All status icons and Apollo states must have explicit accessibilityLabels.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements and key text nodes MUST include a `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid). E.g., testID='gate-status-site-gate', testID='higgins-restore-protection-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native / Expo environment using .js files. Do NOT use web-only paradigms. Default to StyleSheet.
Apply the naming convention strictly: Guard -> Gate (Text Gate, Call Gate, Link Gate, Site Gate, Network Gate, Account Gate). Do NOT rename internal SDKs, API fields, or stored identifiers.
Update `app/(tabs)/guard.js` to implement the new Gates Protection Overview logic.
Ensure Higgins provides written/spoken explanations and actionable status messages ('Your link checks are available, but Site Gate is off...').
Ensure Apollo communicates purely through behavior/animation (Resting, Growling, Barking, Biting) driven by a single unified assessment.
Never describe Higgins as performing blocking.
Handle the PayPal acceptance scenario correctly: investigate callback numbers, do not claim charge is absent without evidence, explain the trap, guide to app.
Retain existing Light Sentinel visual language but apply the new structured rules and labels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive mobile frontends.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (using elevation in RN).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for overlays where text sits on top.
Ensure optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g., adjust padding for buttons with icons).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped, or sharp rectangular with 8px radius) with interaction feedback (TouchableHighlight/TouchableOpacity).
NEVER use generic AI emoji (🤖🧠💭) as primary UI icons. Use standard vector icons.
